item.title: Borno govt swears in six new High Court judges
item.description: Borno State Government has sworn in six newly appointed High Court judges as part of efforts to strengthen justice delivery in the state. The judges were sworn in on Thursday by the Acting Governor, Umar Usman Kadafur, at the Government House in Maiduguri. item.title: Sokoto gov orders arrest of suspects over burning of shelter belts
item.description: Sokoto State Governor, Ahmad Aliyu, has directed security agencies in Wurno Local Government Area to arrest those responsible for setting ablaze shelter belts established to curb desertification in the area. Aliyu gave the directive on Thursday in Wurno. item.title: Two Nigerians arrested over fraud in India
item.description: Gurgaon police cybercrime operatives in India have apprehended two Nigerian nationals for allegedly impersonating directors of Indian companies on WhatsApp to defraud employees. Authorities said the suspects convinced victims to transfer funds into bank accounts controlled by the syndicate. item.title: Nigerian man sentenced to life for murder of UK girlfriend
item.description: A Nottingham Crown Court has handed a life sentence to 40-year-old Adedapo Adegbola for the murder of his former girlfriend, 23-year-old university student, Steph Irons. item.description: The Saudi Pro League has warned Al Nassr captain, Cristiano Ronaldo that “no individual – however significant – determines decisions beyond their own club.” This is a response to Ronaldo’s frustration over his team’s lack of activity the January transfer window.
